subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should this PR hide background-family sessions by default across tray, dashboard, and chat navigation when a general opt-in view exists only on the Sessions page?
rationale: Readable titles address the reported usability problem, but suppressing existing session rows is a separate visibility policy that can change how users discover and return to automation or subagent sessions.

options.title: Approve current visibility policy
options.body: Keep default hiding across ordinary surfaces and require native proof that active background chats remain reachable and the Sessions toggle provides adequate recovery.

options.title: Separate naming from filtering
options.body: Merge readable presentation support first and defer default hiding until every affected surface has an explicit, proven background-session access path.

options.title: Keep all sessions visible
options.body: Use friendly titles and background indicators without changing existing visibility defaults.

recommendation.title: Separate naming from filtering
recommendation.body: Merge readable presentation support first and defer default hiding until every affected surface has an explicit, proven background-session access path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway-client and tray behavior history makes this the best available owner for the cross-surface compatibility decision.
